PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE1.core: Your Mars in the 1st house means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is inseparable from your immediate presence and physical expression. You act visibly. The 1st house is immediate self-presentation, and your Mars here makes your drive, anger, and physical energy part of how you appear. You assert yourself directly through your presence. Your anger shows on your body. Your energy is visible and immediate. You compete through direct confrontation. Passive assertion feels unnatural to your Mars. The challenge is managing the intensity of your presence so that assertion doesn't become aggression that overwhelms others.
PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE1.behavioral: You act immediately, fight openly, and express your drive through your physical presence. When you want something, you go after it visibly. When you're angry, everyone knows it. Your assertion is direct and physical. You don't hide your competitive nature or your desires. This isn't aggression. It's genuine directness. The shadow is that visibility can become intimidation. You may come on too strong without realizing it, or you may use physical presence to dominate when collaboration would work better. The work is developing awareness of your impact, recognizing when your natural intensity needs to be modulated.
PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE1.feed: Mars is moving through your 1st house. Your drive, assertion, and physical energy are at maximum visibility right now. This is a time for direct action, for expressing your desires openly, for trusting that your natural intensity is strength.
PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE1.sonic: Your Mars in the 1st house contributes immediate rhythmic attack, aggressive melodic presence in the foreground, and harmonic drive that is undeniable. The quality of assertion is visible and physical, creating energy through direct presence. Listen for music where the drive is immediate and the force is expressed through physical attack.

PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE2.core: Your Mars in the 2nd house means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is organized around building resources, maintaining security, and working steadily. You act to acquire. The 2nd house is resources and material reality, and your Mars here makes your drive, anger, and energy oriented toward creating financial security and tangible value. You assert yourself through accumulation. Your anger is triggered by threats to your resources. Your energy goes into building and protecting what you own. You compete for material success. Resource insecurity feels intolerable to your Mars. The challenge is recognizing when accumulation has become the goal itself rather than serving your actual needs.
PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE2.behavioral: You act to build resources, fight to protect what's yours, and pursue material security with steady effort. When you want something, you work to earn it. When you're threatened financially, you respond with force. Your assertion is practical and persistent. You compete through sustained effort rather than dramatic bursts. This isn't greed. It's genuine drive for security. The shadow is that accumulation can become compulsive. You may work for resources past the point of actual need, or you may measure all success materially. The work is ensuring that what you're building actually serves your life rather than just satisfying anxiety about security.
PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE2.feed: Mars is moving through your 2nd house. Your drive, assertion, and energy are focused on building resources, creating security, and working steadily right now. This is a time for pursuing material goals, for protecting what's yours, for competing through sustained effort.
PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE2.sonic: Your Mars in the 2nd house contributes steady rhythmic accumulation, grounded harmonic weight, and melodic building through persistence. The quality of assertion is practical and enduring, creating energy through material focus. Listen for music where the drive is sustained and the force builds resources over time.

You act through words. The 3rd house is communication and local connections, and your Mars here makes your drive, anger, and energy oriented toward verbal exchange and intellectual competition. You assert yourself through argument. Your anger is expressed verbally and shifts quickly. Your energy goes into communication, learning, and mental activity. You compete intellectually. Silent assertion feels powerless to your Mars. The challenge is recognizing when verbal aggression is serving your goals versus just satisfying the need to argue.
PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE3.behavioral: You act through conversation, fight with words, and pursue goals through mental agility. When you want something, you argue for it. When you're angry, you express it verbally. Your assertion is intellectual and quick. You compete through debate and wit. This isn't just talking. It's genuine mental combat. The shadow is that verbal aggression can damage relationships. You may argue when you're trying to connect, or you may use words as weapons without recognizing the impact. The work is developing awareness of when intellectual competition serves understanding versus when it's just satisfying your need to win.

You act to protect. The 4th house is home and roots, and your Mars here makes your drive, anger, and energy oriented toward creating and defending sanctuary. You assert yourself when home is threatened. Your anger is tied to family and emotional safety. Your energy goes into building foundation and protecting what's private. You compete to defend your territory. Threats to home feel intolerable to your Mars. The challenge is recognizing when protection has become defensiveness that prevents necessary risk or change.
PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE4.behavioral: You act to protect home and family, fight when sanctuary is threatened, and pursue goals that build emotional foundation. When you want something, it's usually related to making home secure. When you're angry, it's often because someone violated your private space or hurt your family. Your assertion is protective and emotionally motivated. You compete when defending what you love. This isn't aggression. It's genuine protective instinct. The shadow is that protection can become isolation. You may defend so thoroughly that no one can get in, or you may keep your assertion private when public action is needed. The work is channeling your protective drive toward building rather than just defending.

You assert yourself through creative work and romantic pursuit. Your anger is dramatic and tied to wounded pride. Your energy goes into play, creation, and romance. It's genuine energy applied to joy. The shadow is that play can avoid serious commitment. You may pursue many creative projects without finishing any, or you may lose romantic interest once the chase is complete. The work is channeling your creative drive toward goals that deserve sustained effort, not just initial excitement.

The shadow is that principle can override practical wisdom. You may fight for ideals without checking whether fighting serves the actual situation, or you may use belief to justify aggression. The work is ensuring that your fight for meaning actually creates the world you're fighting for.

Your energy goes into collective projects and system improvement. You compete for collective benefit. Selfish goals feel small to your Mars. The challenge is maintaining individual drive within collective action, ensuring your own needs don't disappear into group service.
PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE11.behavioral: You act for groups and shared vision, fight for collective good, and pursue goals that serve the whole. PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE12.core: Your Mars in the 12th house means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is organized around hidden action, spiritual service, and working behind the scenes. You assert yourself indirectly or not at all. Your anger is often turned inward or expressed through passive resistance. Your energy goes into work that doesn't require recognition. You compete compassionately, if at all. Visible assertion feels exposing to your Mars. The challenge is developing enough direct assertion that service doesn't become self-sacrifice, that hidden work doesn't mean having no impact.
PLCMT_MARS_HOUSE12.behavioral: You act behind the scenes, fight indirectly or internally, and pursue goals through private work and spiritual practice. When you want something, you work toward it without needing recognition. When you're angry, you may not show it directly—you might withdraw or express it through subtle means. Your assertion is private and compassionate. You serve without needing credit. This isn't weakness. It's genuine spiritual strength. The shadow is that hiddenness can become avoidance. You may suppress all assertion because directness feels too aggressive, or you may sacrifice yourself entirely without anyone knowing what you've given. The work is developing enough direct assertion that your work actually has the impact it deserves.
